title: All 12 science packs · 1 of each / s

metadata.quantityBasis: Steady-state items/s and fluid units/s, calculated backwards from final demand.
metadata.assumptions: Normal quality; no modules, beacons or researched productivity; selected machines include built-in productivity and biological fuel. Expected probabilistic output; no spoilage in transit. Power, heating, logistics, construction and startup inventory are excluded.
metadata.calculation: Exact rational, nonnegative material balances. Minimize required scrap recycling, then oil refining, then continuous machine equivalents within the selected routes. Credit coproducts and expose unused output as surplus.
metadata.readingOrder: Start at the 1/s target sinks on the right and trace upstream to raw-resource supplies. Bands point in the physical production direction.
